name: golomb_n11__v1_nh
prompt:
Find a Golomb ruler with 11 marks. A Golomb ruler is a set of 11 integers (marks) such that all pairwise distances between marks are unique. The first mark should be at position 0.

Return a list of 11 integers in increasing order representing the mark positions, or state "UNSATISFIABLE" if no solution exists.
